notes.title: Sweet F. Cake patch 1.2 notes
notes.content:
Good afternoon, friends!

We are glad to inform you that your requests have been answered. We introduced the SCROLL FUNCTION. Now you can skip both read and unread text. Do not forget to enable it in the settings!

You can use the function in THREE ways:
- Select "Skip" in the drop-down menu at the top of the game.
- Click on the "Scroll" icon in the lower-left corner of the screen.
- By holding down the Ctrl key.

We hope your life has become better & happier!

But we warn you that the "Scroll" function only remembers text you've read from the moment of installing this update!

Among other things, we fixed several minor, but annoying bugs. Some of you may have lost their achievements in the game gallery(BUT NOT IN STREAM!)

Thank you for your patience! Lisa is waiting for your comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101873/2d571275925dee5beb0e9e41e85e1d0fea5f61f4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sweet F. Cake patch 1.1 notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35101873/b0d210e18a252a15b5d7daa80934e9ed6c087534.png[/img]
Comrades! Today we released a major update, correcting a lot of grammatical and logical errors. Yes, yes, we know that some of them especially spoiled the first impression. But this is not only our fault. Globalization, masons, and a worldwide conspiracy, all this significantly affected the smooth launch of the game.
Also, you may have to start the game again. WTF? !! Oh, don't be upset. When I was a kid, I've stepped into the dog poo. That kind of thing can really ruin your mood. And the game, in which the most delightful wifus await you, ready to sweeten your eyes with their enchanting look once again, is everything but frustrating. Moreover, it is entirely your choice.

In short, all the errors known to us today are fixed. Rejoice! If you want to speed up the reading process, we recommend unrolling the "Text Speed" and "Change scene" sliders to the right (maximum). Soon we will make a special button, which will significantly simplify the process of speedrunning the game.

Details:

[b]Grammar:[/b]
- over9000 grammatical errors.
Narration:
- The hero does not know about the pipe if there was no pipe (what am I talking about? It doesn't matter!).
- The hero will get a lighter where necessary.
- The hero does not know about the kiss with Lisa, if he was not kissing her.
- The hero does not know anything about what did not happen to him.
- Scenes are no longer duplicated.
- In the Lonely Hearts Club, cameras are no longer confused.

[b]Technical errors:[/b]
- Now you can save if the name is the letter "ё".
- Fixed a bug where the game did not continue with quick save.
- Window mode now adjusts to screen size.
- Fixed a bug in which it was impossible to save the game with the name of an existing save.
- Fixed a bug in which, when saving quickly, the frame freezes and the text stops moving.
- Fixed a bug in which a quick save in the elections did not let the story go further.
- Fixed a bug in which saves containing the symbol points were not loaded.


Miss Nataly sends you her greetings!

notes.title: Patch: Extended version (18+ content)
notes.content:
To play the extended version of the game, that includes 18+ content (adult content), download the file from one the links:

1) https://racaty.net/zlpg7vde10dp

2) https://yadi.sk/d/_byympAPF7toFQ

3) https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Xn8ch5qneadTndPSjjj2PIPUUEI8nE62

Installation:
Unzip the archive to the root directory of the game and replace the file.
For example: D: / Games / steam / steamapps / common / Sweet F. Cake
Make sure that "Advanced"option is enabled in the game settings.
